messages.author: acb750e476c0ff5d
messages.subject: changing y-axis label and numbers
parts:
Is there a way to change the y-axis label and numbers in a scaone plot for R/qtl? I was hoping to increase the font size for both.
Thanks

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] changing y-axis label and numbers
parts:
You can use cex.axis to increase the font size of the values on the y-axis scale.
Use cex.lab to change the size of the x-and y-axis labels.
Use xlab and ylab to change the axis labels.

karl

messages.author: acb750e476c0ff5d
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] changing y-axis label and numbers
parts:
Someone suggested adding yaxp to the plot() function. ie. plot(..., yaxp=c(0,7,7)) with 0 being the starting number, the first 7 being the last number, and the second 7 being the total number of labels after the starting number. That seems to have corrected the issue.

Thanks
